svg.text: U_SCAN - actual pipeline and write controls
00 = PLPF n=3 (low toggle) | 11 = PLPF n=1 (unfiltered) | Edge capture uses PRE-edge mode; POST-edge mode prepares the next shift.
Source: core_scan_lwsw.vcd; no expected-schedule signal reconstruction. Buses are hexadecimal; counters/region lengths are decimal.
